recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast vertical split composition featuring a dramatic, close-up male portrait on the right and massive, interlocking sans-serif typography on the left. The lighting is harsh and directional, casting deep shadows that merge into a solid black background.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical center line acts as a hard boundary between the subject and the primary text block.
The subject's shoulder and white shirt overlap into the left typographic field to create depth.
The cream-colored large text contrasts against the black background, while the orange secondary text pops against the subject's torso.
The subject's gaze is direct, creating a psychological anchor against the abstract letterforms.
coreInvariants: Three-color palette: Cream, Black, and Orange

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned in the right half of the frame, cropped tightly from the chest up, filling the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bridge of the nose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, moves left to the massive vertical text, then drops to the bright orange secondary text in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black fills the upper left and far right voids, emphasizing the sharp silhouettes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black provides the deep shadow and background foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cream/Off-white is used for the primary typography and the subject's shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Orange is reserved for the secondary title text in the lower right.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the cream text and black background; low saturation except for the singular orange accent.
paletteRestrictions: No mid-tone grays in the background

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are cropped by the frame edges
Vertical alignment is forced into a rectangular block

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: Single characters or short clusters per line

composition.overlap: Subject overlaps the bottom portion of the text
Placed directly over the subject's chest

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different weights, colors, and scales to create hierarchy.

preserve: Extreme scale of the left-side text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and heavy weight of the display text.
Provides the sharp geometric terminals and classic sans-serif look.
A widely available alternative with similar proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast portrait of a man in a black cowboy hat and white shirt. Use dramatic side-lighting so half the face is in deep shadow. Position him on the right side of a square frame against a solid black background. Leave the left half of the frame mostly empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, cream-colored uppercase sans-serif text on the left side, stacked vertically to fill the height. Add a smaller three-line block of orange uppercase sans-serif text in the bottom right corner, overlapping the subject's shirt.

verificationChecks: Is the left-side text massive and cream-colored?
Is the lighting on the face dramatic with deep shadows?
Is the secondary text bright orange?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (orange could be swapped for cyan or yellow)
Specific typeface (as long as it remains a heavy geometric sans)
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'McGraw'
Do not use the specific title 'Sundown Heaven Town'
Avoid exact facial likeness of the original artist

mustAchieve: Clear visual hierarchy between the two text blocks

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cream text is perfectly vertical and left-aligned.
Check that the orange text is legible against the shirt.
Verify the shadow on the face is deep enough to blend with the background.
Confirm the subject is cropped at the chest and top of the hat.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait on right + Massive vertical sans-serif on left + Small vibrant accent text on bottom right.
